QuestInfo.name: Stormy Chase
QuestInfo.0: What's happening to the White Mage?
QuestInfo.1: The White Mage was engulfed by dark powers.\r\n#b(Exit through the portal on the right to chase down the White Mage.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You must stop the White Mage.

0.0: *Cough cough* I can't believe this... We didn't even touch anything...\r\n#L0##bWhat happened to the White Mage?#l\n#k
0.1: He was engulfed by the ultimate light...

yes.0: The power of light was far too grand. We were fools to think we could comprehend it all, much less control it.
yes.1: I've known the Master was dabbling in the forbidden for some time. I just... I wanted to believe in him. I wondered about the future he was making for us, what he could show us beyond the light.
yes.2: I wish I had time for regrets... *Cough cough* Please. Stop him. It may not be too late.\r\n#b(Exit through the portal on the right to chase after the White Mage.)#k

no.0: Please, stop him. Perhaps there is still time.

default.0: #b(Chase the White Mage into the Aurora Low Forest.)#k
